`antiword-testdoc.doc` is Antiword 0.37's upstream `Docs/testdoc.doc`, supplied
with its GNU GPL source archive. Source, unchanged copyright/license notice,
and build details accompany `splatworks/shared/word-legacy/`. The fixture
contains no user documents; private samples are tested separately and excluded.

`native-format-proof.doc` is an original synthetic test document: a centered
Georgia 16 pt red bold/italic/underlined sentence, followed by normal Arial 10 pt
text. Its source OOXML is in `native-format-proof.xml`. LibreOffice converted the
fixture to Word 97 for testing; no desktop converter is needed at runtime.
